noun_definition: Profile refers to the user interface section where a user can upload and edit their avatar image on the platform.
Limit refers to the maximum allowable file types or size for an Avatar upload that, if exceeded, would trigger an error message and affect the smooth operation of the slider for zooming in or out.
Avatar file type refers to the format of image files that users can upload as their profile picture, which should be limited to ensure smooth functionality of the zoom slider on the profile page.
Size refers to the maximum allowable dimensions or file size of an Avatar image that can be uploaded without causing delays in the scrolling functionality of the slider.
